why.title: Three Reasons to Choose a Japanese Bridal Ring
why.item1_body: Japanese bridal ring artisans inherit traditional metalwork techniques, carefully finishing each ring through dozens of precise steps. Unmatched quality lives in every detail.
why.item2_body: The Eastern aesthetics of 'Mono no Aware' and 'Wabi-sabi' give Japanese rings a quiet beauty unlike anything from European brands — understated, yet deeply meaningful.
why.item3_body: Using Pt950 platinum and carefully selected gemstones, every brand meets Japan's rigorous quality standards — ensuring your rings last as long as your promise.

journal.title: Everything You Want to Know About Japanese Bridal Rings

faq.q1: Can I purchase a Japanese bridal ring from Hong Kong or Taiwan?
faq.a1: Yes. Please contact us via our enquiry form, WhatsApp, or LINE, and we will guide you through each brand's ordering process and shipping arrangements.
faq.q2: What is the price range for Japanese bridal rings?
faq.a2: Prices vary by brand and design. A pair of rings typically ranges from HK$8,000 to HK$50,000 and above. Contact us for a detailed quote from any specific brand.
faq.q3: What is Pt950? How does it differ from white gold?
faq.a3: Pt950 means 95% pure platinum — the most common material used in Japanese bridal rings. It offers superior hardness, corrosion resistance, and lasting brilliance compared to 18K white gold (75% gold).
faq.q4: Can I try on rings at a store in Japan?
faq.a4: Yes. We can assist with appointments at Japanese brand showrooms during your visit to Japan, so you can experience the craftsmanship and feel firsthand.
